items.label: 【Ideal size for indoor and outdoor】
items.value: This fan-shaped plant trellis indoor measures 47.24inch tall and is designed for growing climbing plants and vegetables. items.label: 【Stunning & Decorative Function】

items.label: 【High Quality Material】
items.value: The trellis for climbing plants outdoor is made of high quality aluminum clad plastic, each plant support stakes is 11mm in diameter and has a thick coating to prevent the internal steel tubes from rusting. Benefiting from this, our rose trellis are durable enough to hold up in high winds or heavy rain, solving all the problems you encounter with the weather's impact on your climbing plant support that can span several seasons with your yard.

items.label: 【Easy to Use & Guaranteed Quality】
items.value: This houseplant trellis for climbing plants is easy to install, no screws, no wrench, no screwdriver, the detachable design is easy to assemble and disassemble, and takes up little space.
